sv.title: SB1: ”Mycket attraktivt köpläge” – ser 70 procents uppsida
sv.summary: En kursnedgång på cirka 30 procent från toppen har skapat ett ”mycket attraktivt köpläge” i Lundin Mining. Det skriver SB1 som ser flera faktorer som kan lyfta aktien med 70 procent.

en.title: SB1: "Very attractive buying opportunity" – sees 70 percent upside
en.summary: A share price decline of about 30 percent from the peak has created a "very attractive buying opportunity" in Lundin Mining. SB1 writes that it sees several factors that could lift the stock by 70 percent.
